isolated.method: CPU/robot callbacks invoked once per isolated vector in the initial root action. Clip goto frame getters are immediate; queued native frame scripts have not yet flushed at each row. Snapshot flag fields are retained as observations and are not asserted as post-frame flags. Callback ordering and actual held-track flags require separate live-frame traces.
